dialogs.text: FAMILY CHECK-IN, ONE YEAR AFTER AI.

COUPLE: RESTED.
DOG: WALKED.
TAXES: DONE.
BUT WE FAILED. STILL TWO BABIES BEHIND.

shortPrompt:
Complete this two-frame comic strip. Copy the LAYOUT image exactly: same size,
same black banner and footer bars, same frames, same near-white background.

- LEFT FRAME: only the bot already placed there. NO speech bubbles, NO text.
- RIGHT FRAME: only the reaction bot, where it is placed, with its face changed
  to express DISAPPOINTED: EXAGGERATE IT: drop the character's OWN eyelids heavily so its eyes are barely open and looking DOWN, outer corners sagging; bend its OWN mouth into a deep, wide downward curve; let its antenna/ears droop all the way down. Deeply, theatrically let down - a slow sigh of 'really?' - not crying, not angry. Same character - same head,
  body, base, antenna, ears, colours, line weight. NO speech bubble, NO text.
- NO SPEECH BUBBLES, TAILS OR DIALOG TEXT ANYWHERE. All dialog is added
  afterwards by other software; anything you draw in the frames is erased.
- The space above and around the bots stays plain empty background.
- Faces are smooth, clean, high-resolution line art: no stair-stepped or pixel
  edges on eyes, mouths, antennas or ears. Bot faces and bodies stay WHITE.

BANNER: "#HC045" left | "AI FAMILY CARE" centre | "2028" right. White pixel font.
FOOTER: "HOLY-CHIP.COM" left | "made by rmello © mellodia" right. White pixel font. One line.

(For context only - draw none of it: the left bot says "FAMILY CHECK-IN, ONE YEAR AFTER AI.", "COUPLE: RESTED.
DOG: WALKED.
TAXES: DONE.", "BUT WE FAILED. STILL TWO BABIES BEHIND.", "WHY DO WE NEED BABIES?", "THEIR DOG IS LONELY."; the reaction bot answers "HOLY CHIP !!".)
